sect1.title: LogicalFileListFiltered

row.entry: Optional. A null-terminated string containing the mask pattern of the files to list. If omitted, the default is '*' (all files).

Optional. A comma-separated string of filter expressions for advanced filtering. Attribute expressions are combined with AND; if multiple is: expressions are supplied, the last one takes precedence. See the supported syntax and field names below. If omitted, the default is '' (no filtering).

Optional. A comma-separated string specifying which fields to return in the result set. For any non-empty value, the filename field ('name') is always included even if you do not request it explicitly. Examples include 'name' for just the filename, 'size' for filename and size, or 'superfile,owner' for filename, superfile, and owner. If omitted or empty, the default is the legacy field subset 'name,superfile,size,rowcount,modified,owner,cluster'. Request any additional fields you want explicitly.
Optional. A boolean flag indicating whether to set unknown numeric result values, including file sizes and row counts, to zero (0) instead of minus-one (-1). If omitted, the default is FALSE.

Optional. The name of the remote DFS service used to resolve the file. If blank then the file is resolved locally. If omitted, the default is blank. (Not yet supported; specifying this will raise an error.)
Optional. Maximum number of files to return. Set to -1 to use server default limit (100,000). Maximum client-side limit is 1,000,000. If omitted, the default is -1.
LogicalFileListFiltered returns a record containing count, limitBreached, and a dataset of file information in the format shown below.

listitem.para: field:pattern matches a value using wildcards, for example owner:*smith.

field=value matches an exact value. Integer equality treats missing properties as zero, so rowcount=0 also matches files without a stored row count. Use has:rowcount,rowcount=0 to require an explicitly stored zero. Boolean and floating-point equality compare stored text, not typed values: persistent=1 does not match stored true, and readCost=1 does not match stored 1.0. Missing Boolean properties do not match equality filters, including persistent=0; use !has:persistent to select files where that property is absent.

field>value, field>=value, field<value, and field<=value compare numeric fields. String fields support only the inclusive forms >= and <=, for example modified>=2026-01-01. Date bounds compare full timestamp strings, so modified<=2026-01-01 excludes timestamps on January 1, not just later days. Bounds containing : (such as a time of day) are rejected by the parser. To select all January 1 timestamps, use modified>=2026-01-01,modified<=2026-01-02; the date-only upper bound excludes January 2 timestamps.
has:field tests whether a property exists; !has:field tests whether it does not, for example !has:description.
is:superfile selects SuperFiles, is:normal selects normal files, and is:any selects both (the default).

sect1.para: Recognized field names (case-insensitive); use namepattern to filter file names:

listitem.para: String and date: description, group, kind, modified, job, owner, workunit, accessed, directory, partmask, superowners, protect, subfilenames.

Integer: recordcount, recordSize, size, numsubfiles (currently not usable for numeric filtering; use is:superfile or is:normal for file type), numparts, compressedSize, numDiskReads, numDiskWrites, maxSkew, minSkew, maxSkewPart, minSkewPart, expireDays.

Floating-point: cost, atRestCost, accessCost, readCost, writeCost. Cost filters use stored cost_type amounts in millionths of a currency unit: readCost>=1 means at least one millionth, not one currency unit. Use readCost>=1000000 for at least one currency unit. Filters on cost, atRestCost, and accessCost inspect stored attributes, not internally calculated costs. These three fields are not returned by this function. Filters cannot use the internally calculated values; for example, atRestCost>0 does not select files based on their calculated at-rest cost.

Boolean: persistent, compressed, blockCompressed, rowCompressed. The compressed filter reads the stored Attr/@compressed attribute, not the returned compression status, which can be derived from other flags or the file kind. Use blockCompressed and rowCompressed to filter their respective stored flags, Attr/@blockCompressed and Attr/@rowCompressed.

sect1.para: group (and its cluster alias) filters the stored Attr/@group value, not the file's root @group cluster names. For example, group:thor does not select files by their root cluster name. Value filters for protect and subfilenames do not inspect the metadata used for file protection or SuperFile contents. Existence filters (has: and !has:) for protect, subfilenames, and numsubfiles likewise test attributes that do not represent that metadata; they do not detect file protection or whether a SuperFile contains subfiles. Subfile names are not returned by this function. superowners value filters inspect the SuperOwner element rather than its @name; for example, superowners:*scope* does not match a superowner name.

Aliases are rowcount for recordcount, cluster for group, and superfile for numsubfiles. To select files by type, use is:superfile or is:normal instead of comparing superfile numerically. Separate expressions with commas, not spaces. Only has: supports the ! prefix; OR and other negations are not supported. Floating-point comparisons with >, >=, <, or <= currently require an integer value.

The LogicalFileListFiltered function returns a record containing the number of files returned, a flag indicating whether the result was limited by maxFileLimit, and a dataset of logical files in the environment with enhanced filtering and detailed file information.
